gates.evidence: The proposal includes explicit eligibility checks for sensitive content contexts.
The reward is an in-app feature (posting a comment), not cash, gift cards, or other incentivized clicks/installs.
No loss framing is used; the approach is a gain-framed opportunity to engage as a guest.
The user must tap the 'Post as Guest' button, which is clearly labeled, to trigger the rewarded ad offer.
The offer clearly states: 'Play a quick game with AOL to post this comment instantly'.
A 'No Thanks' button is clearly provided.
The offer appears at the comment posting wall, not during article reading or AI generation.
Eligibility is restricted to non-logged-in users.

scores.evidence: The offer appears at the exact moment a user hits the sign-up wall, offering a solution to their immediate goal.
The guest comment pass feels native to the article discussion flow, preserving the draft and user input.
Gated to non-logged-in users only; no substitution for paid tiers, as AOL has no commenting subscription.
COGS ($0.0018) is significantly below the US net revenue per view ($0.0090–$0.0150).
Commenting is part of the core article loop, though hit rates depend on users who choose to comment.
Integration is straightforward, though it requires a backend mechanism for handling temporary guest comment posting.
Uses the AOL app context, though it could be more descriptive regarding the specific AOL-branded Game Partner characters.
Includes primary KPIs, guardrails, and a user-level holdout for validation.
